feedback.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my Pro subscription on September 25th - two charges of $49 each. I only have one account. Can you please refund the extra charge? Thanks.

classification.rationale: The feedback states 'charged twice for my Pro subscription' and requests a refund for the 'extra charge,' indicating a billing issue with significant impact that needs same-day action.

summary: The customer, Bob Tran, reports being charged twice for his Pro subscription on September 25th and requests a refund for the extra $49 charge. Order history confirms two separate paid orders for the Pro plan on that date, each for $49, indicating a duplicate charge.
customer_context: Customer record found: Bob Tran (C002), Pro plan, single seat, monthly spend $49, customer since July 2025. Two paid orders for the Pro plan on September 25th, each for $49, confirming the duplicate charge. No open tickets or ongoing issues.

references.title: Handling Billing Issues
references.relevance: Specifies steps for verifying duplicate charges and issuing refunds without approval if under $500.

references.title: Refund Policy
references.relevance: Mandates full refund for duplicate charges regardless of the 14-day window; no approval needed for refunds under $500.

suggested_actions.action: Issue a full refund of $49 for the duplicate Pro plan charge on September 25th and notify the customer of the expected processing time (5-10 business days).
Confirm to the customer that the duplicate charge has been refunded and provide details on the refund amount and processing timeline.
